subject: Count-test fix landed on claude/naadi-shared (f35acaa): rebase, then pack content no longer breaks test_data / test_packs / db test_seed
body: Standalone commit f35acaa. tests/seed/pack_totals.py counts each pack straight from data/content/<pack>/*.json; test_data, test_packs (sample sets filtered to sample-pack) and tests/db/test_seed.py now expect legacy + sum(packs). Legacy rows stay pinned. tests/seed/test_svg.py and tests/authoring/test_lint_cli.py only read the legacy files, so they were left alone. Verified: tests/seed + tests/content (51 passed) and tests/db/test_seed.py + test_live_check.py on a local stack, both with empty packs and with my 324 items. seg23-core: please review.
